facts: Quantum Data independently tracks Infleqtion as a public U.S. neutral-atom quantum company under ticker INFQ.
Its event timeline records Infleqtion's September 24, 2026 report of 30 entangled logical qubits on Sqale using 80 physical qubits.

It independently summarizes the August revenue-recognition correction and revised approximately $45.1M 2026 guidance, preserving the accounting-quality caveat rather than treating issuer guidance as uncontested fact.

Investing.com's Citi conference coverage reports that Infleqtion described revenue from quantum sensors, computers and software, with customers including U.S. and U.K. governments and commercial buyers.
The coverage reports three quantum-computer sales/deployments to Illinois, the United Kingdom and Japan's Institute for Molecular Science and a recent NASA award adding $20M of contract value.

The same coverage flags the long commercialization runway: management targeted practical quantum advantage around 100 logical qubits by end-2028, so present revenue traction does not itself establish utility-scale fault tolerance.

observations: Independent specialist and financial-media origins now corroborate material portions of the issuer/SEC commercialization narrative without sharing issuer or SEC origin fingerprints.
Commercial evidence spans sensing, computing and software rather than a single product claim, supporting cross-division optionality while leaving economics and margins for Alpha underwriting.
The revenue-recognition correction remains material to data confidence and should stay visible in Alpha's risk/confidence construction.
risks: Independent coverage still relies partly on management statements for forward technical targets and contract-value descriptions.
Logical-qubit progress does not prove economic quantum advantage, scalable margins or customer ROI.
Revenue-recognition correction increases the need for filing-level reconciliation of normalized revenue, cash burn and guidance.
contradictions: Commercial traction and reported logical-qubit progress coexist with a multi-year path to the management-stated practical-advantage threshold.
Raised revenue guidance coexists with a recent revenue-recognition correction, so top-line momentum should not be treated as high-confidence without Alpha reconciliation.
unknowns: Customer concentration and contract-to-recurring-revenue conversion remain unknown here.
Normalized gross margin, operating cash burn and economics of deployed quantum systems remain Alpha-owned.
Independent technical replication of the 30-logical-qubit result was not established by this assist.
changedStrategy: Used independent specialist and financial-media origins rather than repeating issuer/SEC sources already represented in the packet.
